reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is "moresafe" (constant). Although user input flows into valuesList at index 1, the sequence add("safe") -> add(param) -> add("moresafe") creates a list ["safe", param, "moresafe"]. The call remove(0) deletes the first element ("safe"), shifting the list to [param, "moresafe"]. Subsequently, get(1) retrieves the element at index 1, which is the constant "moresafe", not the user parameter. Thus, no attacker-controlled data reaches the response writer.

evidence.note: User input added to list alongside constants, establishing initial order.
